task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-03 at src/design/adp-03-tenant-context-resolution-api.md. Define tenant context resolution semantics for API requests based on bearer token claims: tokens without tenant_id resolve deterministically to default tenant, tokens with tenant_id scope all operations to that tenant, and no request may cross tenant boundaries. Specify middleware/service boundary contracts, default-tenant compatibility behavior, required validation/error outcomes for missing/invalid tenant claims, and how tenant context is propagated to persistence/query layers. Include explicit traceability to API-08 and OIDC-13 plus impacted storage constraints from ADP-01/ADP-02. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design specifies deterministic tenant resolution rules for tokens with and without tenant_id
Cross-tenant isolation invariants for request lifecycle are explicit and testable
Validation and error-handling boundaries are clearly defined for invalid tenant context
Traceability maps ADP-03 behavior to API-08, OIDC-13, ADP-01, and ADP-02
Output is implementation-ready for BACKEND-DEV without interpretation gaps

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-03 tenant context resolution on API, defining deterministic claim/default tenant semantics, middleware-to-service contracts, isolation invariants, validation/error boundaries, and propagation to ADP-01/ADP-02 scoped persistence.
